notes.container-verification: One executor container holds Hermes, its agents and product work; the host sidecar runs credential valves and the Supercode/OA SDK reporter. The existing launchd → World lifecycle manages it, with 3072 MiB memory / 16384 MiB writable-storage admission reservations. No Codex app-server bridge or extra executor port remains. Current image oa-kit-local-runtime:native-tools carries published World 0.1.7, core 0.1.3, Supercode SHA256 3fc2856e73d684f3392512b1b8a203befa1934e49a2ca41c2ee79e08d8bf5579, and the native thread authorization backport (authz_mixin.py SHA256 da6a879f6b10ce07cc791e087710c3b1e980bc779e21771c728f64a53e3f008f). Upstream authorization review remains pending; 71 selected tests passed for the upstream fix and pinned backport. Installed project source is PR #50 merge 838b37cabc1d6312b22e679639250a6aaa75329b. Host reporter/container helpers are explicit kit divergences documented in PRODUCTION.md. Runtime doctor, native gateway status and attached product check passed after restart on 2026-09-10 UTC. Both profiles use native terminal.shell_init_files to activate /opt/hermes/.venv/bin/activate after login-shell initialization. A real Hermes terminal tool imported cron.jobs and hermes_cli.config successfully; Docker PATH alone did not pass this check and was removed. Service unloading finishes its own World teardown before restart. Sources: https://github.com/open-autonomy-org/evidence-desk/pull/49, https://github.com/open-autonomy-org/evidence-desk/pull/50, https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/106950, https://github.com/volter-ai/supercode/pull/809. Native shell initialization and its setup acceptance requirement are included in the template, all cookbooks and this installation; the unchanged OA root check passed in 13.4 seconds. Source: https://github.com/open-autonomy-org/open-autonomy/pull/565. The installed World CLI is linked into /usr/local/bin so native login shells retain that command without manual PATH prefixes. The first successor worker t_23847d50 exposed the stock image’s /opt/data-only native file-write boundary. The managed image now sets HERMES_WRITE_SAFE_ROOT=/opt/data:/work/project. Actual native write_file and patch operations passed in a disposable checkout subdirectory; unrelated paths and protected credential paths remain denied. The existing blocked task is resumed after installation rather than recreated.
